budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Deliver two supplies for each polity while scouting, paying finite signal costs, interpreting expiring warnings, and committing caravans to safe-stop road segments.
task.natural_termination: Success when all three delivery counts reach two. Failure when any polity's bank plus caravan cargo plus already delivered supplies falls below two, making its required delivery impossible.
task.interaction: Tending a tower spends shared finite fuel to give peers a dated, finite-lived hazard snapshot. Their later segment commitments encounter actual moving hazards and shared road occupancy; a blocked caravan can lose cargo while waiting, while alternative lanes cost extra scout/driver time.
task.observation_access: Partially observable. Static map, safe stops, destinations, towers/fuel, delivery totals, signal flags and phase are public. Scouts have radii 3,3,4. A role also sees hazards within one of its own caravan and always knows its own caravan/home; other scouts, caravans and homes require scout sight. Invisible fields are -1 with explicit masks. Warning entities show only their recipient's stored snapshot, direction, timestamp and remaining lifetime. A live warning never reveals the actual hazard's current state; actual hazard entity visibility remains local. Per-role blocked/loss flags are private observation fields and are not public scene events.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Public flags for scouts who transmitted this step.
Public cumulative delivered supplies by owner.
Current t mod 3; hazards advance on resulting phase zero, excluding reset.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
